lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Spring at Crown Hollow. Three keys are still|on the road. One is already here, of course.
lines.text: Spring at Crown Hollow. Three keys are still on the road. One is already here, of course.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Two days early. I'm always early.|That's the problem, isn't it?
lines.text: Two days early. I'm always early. That's the problem, isn't it?

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Six stakes, one line. The Hollow can't feed|on this bank. Don't hand it the other one.
lines.text: Six stakes, one line. The Hollow can't feed on this bank. Don't hand it the other one.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: So I just... stand here. For fourteen minutes.
lines.text: So I just... stand here. For fourteen minutes.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: The spark first, then the storm. Today the|spark waits. I'll be below, talking to the sky.
lines.text: The spark first, then the storm. Today the spark waits. I'll be below, talking to the sky.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Little ember. You came alone.|You always come alone.
lines.text: Little ember. You came alone. You always come alone.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Not alone. Early.|There's a difference. I'm told.
lines.text: Not alone. Early. There's a difference. I'm told.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: My door is open, Queen of Fire.|Come and close it. You know you want to.
lines.text: My door is open, Queen of Fire. Come and close it. You know you want to.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I really do. I'm not going to.|Somebody write that down.
lines.text: I really do. I'm not going to. Somebody write that down.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Girl! The water is the line.|Every step past it, it eats.
lines.text: Girl! The water is the line. Every step past it, it eats.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Yes. Closer. Hungry fire feeds me best.
lines.text: Yes. Closer. Hungry fire feeds me best.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Scouts on the far bank, my queen!|Pinned at the old wagon road!
lines.text: Scouts on the far bank, my queen! Pinned at the old wagon road!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Hold the ford for them.|They run to us. We do NOT run to them.
lines.text: Hold the ford for them. They run to us. We do NOT run to them.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Did the queen just say "we do not run"?|I'm putting that in the regiment book.
lines.text: Did the queen just say "we do not run"? I'm putting that in the regiment book.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Every rider home! The queen waited!|Somebody ring a bell!
lines.text: Every rider home! The queen waited! Somebody ring a bell!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Vey! I called. And look:|still on my side of the river.
lines.text: Vey! I called. And look: still on my side of the river.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: I see it. First time in|twenty years. Don't spoil it.
lines.text: I see it. First time in twenty years. Don't spoil it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: That's what waiting buys you,|girl. Lightning, on time.
lines.text: That's what waiting buys you, girl. Lightning, on time.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: The line is broken. Feed me,|little ember. Feed me everything.
lines.text: The line is broken. Feed me, little ember. Feed me everything.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The last tide climbs out of the Hollow.|On the hills behind it, three banners rise.
lines.text: The last tide climbs out of the Hollow. On the hills behind it, three banners rise.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ice, on the north road.|You waited for us, child? Truly?
lines.text: Ice, on the north road. You waited for us, child? Truly?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: She waited. I watched her do it.|I may need to sit down.
lines.text: She waited. I watched her do it. I may need to sit down.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Don't all stare. I was invited.|Especially, I'm told.
lines.text: Don't all stare. I was invited. Especially, I'm told.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Four keys. One hole in the|ground. Let's go and knock.
lines.text: Four keys. One hole in the ground. Let's go and knock.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Too early... too early again...
lines.text: Too early... too early again...

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: They're at the keep! Emberguard, hold! HOLD!
lines.text: They're at the keep! Emberguard, hold! HOLD!
